candidate.title: Admin group addmembers accepts unbounded comma-separated usernames, causing N+1 queries and long-running request
reports: no cap on the size of the usernames param in addmembers, allowing clients to submit thousands of names and produce an unbounded loop of queries in one request

app/controllers/admin/groupscontroller.rb:71 — usernames are not stripped and the list length is uncapped: one request with thousands of comma-separated names does one findbyusername plus insert each, serially.

[low/security] app/controllers/admin/groupscontroller.rb (addmembers) — no cap on number of usernames per request; arbitrarily large list causes n queries + group.add calls in a transaction-free loop (potential dos / partial-failure state with no rollback)
